csv.source_claim: User-supplied Binance CSV; provenance not independently verified

limitations: Already studied retrospective August/September, not blind OOS.
Binance-format source user-provided, not independently authenticated.
Fixed-path cost budgets do not predict different-cost executions.
No spread/funding/borrow/liquidity/latency model; SHORT virtual collateral, not tradable Spot short.
Forced final liquidation; no final open position by design; fresh split ledgers.
No production activation or parameter optimization.

ZERO_COST.purpose: Actual independent simulations with fixed signals; gates, stops, fills and sizing can differ; not simple subtraction or optimized tariff

protocol.economics: Net=filled-price gross-fees. Raw-path gross approximates filled gross+slippage (rounding residual explicit). Turnover=sum filled entry/exit notional. Fixed-realized-path break-even fee bps=gross filled PnL/turnover*10000; ceiling tick residual; negative means no nonnegative fee can make path profitable. Raw-path total-cost budget bps=raw gross/raw turnover*10000 is first-order attribution, not a tradable break-even quote. No fee/slippage fitting.
protocol.execution: Unchanged app.lab.execution; next open, conservative SL first including ambiguous candles, adverse stop gaps, capped TP gaps, protective opening priority, final liquidation, ignored occupied entries, no same-open reversal
protocol.limits: Input existing16MiB/20000 rows; CPU default180s maximum600s; standalone offline only; no private clients, environment credentials or database writes
protocol.network: Single official January2023 checksum probe8s returned ConnectError; no retry/bypass; no archives received.
protocol.new_history_protocol: If official archives available: fixed development2020-2022 and new retrospective validation2023-2025 before looking at outcomes;500 past warm-up, BTC15m. No claiming unviewed/blind holdout. Only complete authenticated intervals; otherwise blocked.
protocol.parameters: Exact frozen A/B/C/D from parent protocol; no thresholds/indicator changes

periods.test: 2026-08-01 UTC to 2026-10-01 exclusive;8832 causal past bars; fresh ledger

protocol.regimes: Past ADX14 at signal candle; RANGE<=20, TREND>=25, otherwise TRANSITION; attribution only
protocol.reporting: Full baseline trade journals. Full15m equity calculated/audited, JSON includes daily/start/end equity points only to bound storage; reproducing CLI can emit full curves using --full-curves. Zero-cost summaries only. Equal net samples do not imply matching positions.

variants.I: Invert entry direction only. Retain original exit_long/exit_short associated with PHYSICAL position side. Stop/target ATR distances unchanged, centered on new direction at actual next-open fill. This can cause immediate strategy exits; explicit hypothesis, not guessed mirrored holding time.
variants.II: Invert entry direction and SWAP original exit_long/exit_short. Preserve original directional exit trajectory for inverted position. ATR distances unchanged, centered on new fill. No reflection of price history, RSI thresholds or trend regime.
variants.ORIGINAL: Unchanged decisions and exits; rerun equals original report
